ideas.pitch: Decentralized machine-to-machine payment gateway using MST Blockchain and AI agents for autonomous drone and robot task settlement.
ideas.title: MST-Newrro Autonomous Robot Fleet Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets both co-organizers core competencies—MST Blockchain and Newrro robotics—by creating a working autonomous payment layer for physical hardware.

ideas.pitch: Zero-knowledge authenticated IoT sensor telemetry pipeline verifying industrial environmental data on MST Blockchain.
ideas.title: DePIN Sensor Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines DePIN, hardware telemetry, and cryptographic proof generation which heavily appeals to infrastructure judges at a Layer 1 blockchain hackathon.

ideas.pitch: Edge-AI powered waste sorting and classification node built for automated sorting conveyor belts using computer vision models.
ideas.title: RoboGarbage AI Vision Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an unusual physical hardware build with a live working demo, matching proven winning patterns for robotics and embedded systems.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous AI agent that dynamically reallocates real-world asset token yields across liquidity pools on MST Blockchain based on risk heuristics.
ideas.title: AgentRWA Yield Automator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Merges AI agents and Real World Assets (RWA) into a single functional protocol demo with clear utility for decentralized finance.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous rover mapping indoor spaces while concurrently anchoring spatial waypoint hashes onto MST Blockchain for verifiable navigation logs.
ideas.title: EdgeRover SLAM Telemetry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges robotics navigation with ledger immutability, providing judges with a tangible, highly complex physical demo that stands out in a room full of pure web apps.
